info.title: Diagram Studio API
info.description: Private versioned drafts and immutable public snapshots. JSON request bodies are limited to 1 MB. See contract.md for cookie, CSRF, and document constraints.

get.description: Returns the current account and a CSRF token. Creates an anonymous session when signed out.

post.description: Generic response for all addresses. Sends to verified accounts only, at most once per minute. SMTP failure returns 503.

Consumes a single-use six-digit reset code with ten-minute expiry and five attempts; resets password, revokes all sessions and records a security event. Does not sign in. Verification codes cannot reset passwords.

put.description: Updates the signed-in display name. Email cannot be changed here.

post.description: Requires current password. Changes the password, revokes all sessions and pending resets, and records an account security event. Sign in again afterwards.
Revokes every session, including the current one, using a credential version checked on authenticated API requests.

get.description: Latest twenty owned account security events, newest first. No credentials or session tokens.

post.description: Creates an unverified account and sends an email code. SMTP failure rolls back registration.
Consumes a six-digit code; expires in ten minutes or five attempts. Does not sign in.
Generic acknowledgement; sends only to unverified accounts, at most once per minute. Replaces prior code.
Signs in. Passwords are compared using bcrypt. Errors do not reveal which credential was wrong.
Invalidates the current session. Fetch /auth/me again before the next write.

get.description: Returns owned audit events, including events for deleted projects. Document content and credentials are excluded.
Returns a bounded searchable page of owned projects.

post.description: Creates an owned private draft. Node IDs must be unique and steps must reference existing nodes.

get.description: Loads an owned draft; returns 404 for nonexistent and non-owned IDs.

put.description: Saves only if the supplied version matches. Version increments on every save.

delete.description: Deletes the owned draft and revokes its published links.

get.description: Lists the latest 50 publications for an owned project.

post.description: Atomically copies the matching draft version into a new immutable publication. Review flags are excluded.

get.description: Lists the owner’s latest 100 saved revisions in descending order.
Loads an owned immutable revision. Other owners and missing versions return 404.

post.description: Restores revisionVersion as a new draft version if the current version still matches. Earlier revisions and publications stay unchanged.

get.description: Public playback document. Does not expose the owner or current draft.

post.description: Creates an independent private project owned by the signed-in reader.

cookieAuth.name: DIAGRAM_SESSION
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookie. Anonymous sessions also receive a cookie for CSRF.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
csrfToken.description: Fetch /auth/me and send csrfToken on writes.
